name: Hostinger Mail
description: Hostinger Mail helps users discover mailbox operations, inspect mailboxes and folders, read or search messages, send email, and manage message or webhook state in their authenticated Hostinger Mail account.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Hostinger Mail to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Hostinger Mail to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.mail.hostinger.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Hostinger Mail MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hostinger Mail provides these MCP tools: email_api_docs, email_call_api_delete, email_call_api_read, email_call_api_write, email_describe_operation, and email_list_operations.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Hostinger Mail?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Hostinger Mail in communication on the Manufact MCP catalog include AgentLine: Phone Numbers for AI Agents, JooVoice, OpenMail, Granola, and Fleet Connected Apps.

_published_faq.name: Does Hostinger Mail MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hostinger Mail requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Hostinger Mail is developed by Hostinger. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
